about: Anderson Injury Lawyers says it was founded in 2007 and serves Dallas and the wider metroplex, with verified offices in Dallas, two in Fort Worth and one in Austin. Its own structured data leads with Dallas.

It is one of the few firms in this market that publishes a fee statement rather than only a promise, and one of two whose site passes Core Web Vitals outright. Its team page names nobody a person could check, which is what G5 asks for and why that gate does not pass.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 4 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 4 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Franchise Taxpayers (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm), published as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, which carries the Secretary of State file number, charter date and status and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed. The franchise tax does not reach a sole proprietorship or a general partnership, so this register can confirm an entity and cannot rule one out.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 16 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 2,278 public client reviews across 4 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2006-08-22, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

json_ld_descriptions: Anderson Injury Lawyers is a Texas personal injury law firm serving Dallas and the surrounding DFW metroplex. Founded in 2007, our team of experienced attorneys represents victims of car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle crashes, workplace injuries, wrongful death, and more. We are dedicated to fighting for maximum compensation on behalf of injured Texans and their families. Our firm operates on a contingency fee basis — you pay nothing unless we win. With offices in Dallas, Fort Worth, and Austin, we are positioned to serve clients across the state. We offer free consultations and provide services in both English and Spanish. Recognized for our client-first approach and proven track record, Anderson Injury Lawyers has earned hundreds of five-star reviews from satisfied clients throughout Texas.

Anderson Injury Lawyers is a Texas-based personal injury law firm founded in 2007. With offices in Fort Worth, Dallas, and Austin, our attorneys represent clients injured in car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle crashes, workplace incidents, wrongful death cases, brain injuries, rideshare accidents, and daycare injuries. We serve clients across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex and throughout Texas, including communities in Tarrant, Dallas, Collin, Denton, and Travis counties. Our legal team is committed to securing maximum compensation for injured Texans on a contingency fee basis — no recovery, no fee. We offer free consultations, provide bilingual services in English and Spanish, and are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Anderson Injury Lawyers has built a strong reputation for client advocacy, transparency, and results-driven representation across the state of Texas.
